findings.evidenceJa: 散々こじれた作戦会議
findings.governingReading: a strategy meeting that had become thoroughly tangled
findings.explanation: The difficulty is disagreement and complication, not simply the volume of conversation.

findings.highlight: I expected it not to finish so easily
findings.evidenceJa: 気合いをいれて会合に臨んだ
findings.governingReading: I steeled myself as I entered the meeting
findings.explanation: Shirou’s active preparation for a difficult debate disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 実にすっぱり結論を出した
findings.governingReading: Rin reaches an admirably crisp conclusion
findings.explanation: The speed and clean decisiveness that overturn Shirou’s expectation disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 雨戸を開けた
findings.governingReading: opens the storm shutters
findings.explanation: The exterior shutters that expose the veranda to winter air become an ordinary sliding door.

findings.highlight: Do you want to sit here with me
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと付き合わない
findings.governingReading: Will you keep me company for a bit
findings.explanation: Rin asks for Shirou’s company, not specifically for the already-occurring act of sitting.

findings.evidenceJa: 肩が触れる距離
findings.governingReading: close enough that our shoulders would surely touch
findings.explanation: Passive accidental proximity becomes Shirou’s active capacity or intent to touch Rin.

findings.highlight: I just thought that you might be fine
findings.evidenceJa: 人のふり見て我がふり直せじゃないけど
findings.governingReading: Not exactly “observe another’s conduct and correct your own,” but seeing this house made me wonder whether you might be fine as you are
findings.explanation: The entire proverb and the house-as-comparative-evidence logic disappear, leaving Rin’s conclusion unsupported.

findings.evidenceJa: 四方の門
findings.governingReading: the gates on all four sides
findings.explanation: The bounded workshop’s gates in every direction become ordinary house doors.

findings.evidenceJa: わたし自身そういう在り方が気に入っちゃってる
findings.governingReading: I myself have come to like being this way
findings.explanation: Rin’s acceptance of her own guarded mode of being becomes approval of the mansion’s condition.

findings.evidenceJa: 吐息の残滓は白く
findings.governingReading: The remnant of her breath hangs white
findings.explanation: The visible vapor left by Rin’s exhalation is attributed to the sigh itself.

findings.evidenceJa: その横顔を盗み見て
findings.governingReading: Stealing a glance at her profile
findings.explanation: The furtive intimacy and side-on view that trigger Shirou’s memory disappear.

findings.highlight: by acting like a perfect magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師として完璧になればなるほど
findings.governingReading: the more perfect she becomes as a magus
findings.explanation: Shirou fears that actual excellence and formation as a magus kills Rin’s personal self; mirror moon reduces this to performative behavior.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛っていう自分
findings.governingReading: the self called Tohsaka Rin
findings.explanation: The explicit personhood and name Shirou fears she is killing become an abstract “true self.”

findings.highlight: there’s no need for you to worry
findings.evidenceJa: 心配は杞憂
findings.governingReading: your worry is groundless
findings.explanation: Rin does not merely reassure Shirou; she classifies his concern as an unfounded fear.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に気持ちのいい笑み
findings.governingReading: a genuinely open, refreshing smile
findings.explanation: The narration’s positive judgment of Rin’s unforced smile disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 基本的に快楽主義者
findings.governingReading: I am fundamentally a hedonist
findings.explanation: Rin’s concise self-description as someone governed by pleasure becomes a looser claim of adventurous willingness.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が面白いから
findings.governingReading: because I find you interesting
findings.explanation: Rin’s interest in Shirou becomes a claim that he is comical.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛は自由に、自分のやりたいように
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka Rin has freely lived as she herself wished
findings.explanation: The key correction that Rin acts freely, despite lineage, loses its explicit freedom and self-directed emphasis.

findings.evidenceJa: もちろんそういう衛宮くんも楽しかったんでしょ？
findings.governingReading: And of course it was fun for you too, wasn’t it?
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts a causal link to Shirou’s previous remark; Rin actually treats his enjoyment as an obvious parallel assumption.

findings.evidenceJa: 必死にしがみついただけ
findings.governingReading: I did nothing but cling to it desperately
findings.explanation: The desperation driving Shirou to imitate Kiritsugu disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 死を背中に押し当てながら
findings.governingReading: with death pressed against my back each night
findings.explanation: The bodily image of death held against Shirou from behind becomes the conventional and differently oriented phrase “facing death.”

findings.evidenceJa: 神経を研ぎ澄ました
findings.governingReading: I sharpened every nerve
findings.explanation: A bodily account of dangerous Magic Circuit training becomes vague perceptual sensitivity.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の修行も、魔術そのものも
findings.governingReading: neither magecraft training nor magecraft itself
findings.explanation: The practice that structures Shirou’s ideal is again generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: ally of justice
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recurring ethical ideal becomes a genre identity associated with powers and public heroics.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分から楽しいって思える事
findings.governingReading: something you can find enjoyable from within yourself, of your own initiative
findings.explanation: Rin’s contrast between other-directed gladness and self-originating enjoyment disappears, weakening the central diagnosis.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな余分な願い
findings.governingReading: such an extraneous desire
findings.explanation: Shirou does not merely feel unqualified to wish; he categorizes personal enjoyment as surplus beyond what he is permitted.

findings.highlight: not caring for your own self
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に焦点があってない
findings.governingReading: your focus is never aligned with yourself
findings.explanation: Rin diagnoses a structural absence of self-directed perspective, not merely insufficient self-care.

findings.evidenceJa: 鼻先に指を向ける
findings.governingReading: jabs a finger toward the tip of my nose
findings.explanation: The aggressive proximity that leads directly to her nail touching Shirou’s nose disappears.

findings.highlight: I always thought you two were alike
findings.evidenceJa: 似てる似てるって思ってた
findings.governingReading: I kept thinking how alike you were
findings.explanation: mirror moon explicitly introduces a second person even though the Japanese withholds Rin’s comparison target at this point.

findings.evidenceJa: 言うなりになるしかない
findings.governingReading: I have no choice but to do exactly as she says
findings.explanation: Shirou’s helpless acquiescence to Rin’s anger becomes an autonomous decision simply to remain quiet.

findings.highlight: as if smacking me with a glove
findings.evidenceJa: 手袋を叩きつけるような口調
findings.governingReading: in a tone like throwing down a gauntlet
findings.explanation: A challenge metaphor becomes an image of Rin hitting Shirou with a glove.

findings.highlight: I was cornered and had to surrender
findings.evidenceJa: 降参しろと追い詰められた
findings.governingReading: she cornered me while demanding that I surrender
findings.explanation: mirror moon states that Shirou surrendered, contradicting the same sentence’s point that Rider interrupted before resolution.

findings.evidenceJa: 首を洗って待ってなさい
findings.governingReading: Wash your neck and wait
findings.explanation: The literal wording of the prepare-for-death idiom disappears, making Shirou’s next thought about actually washing his neck unintelligible.

findings.highlight: I’ll smack you a good one
findings.evidenceJa: とっておきにスペシャルなのを味わわせてやる
findings.governingReading: I will treat you to something especially special I have in reserve
findings.explanation: Rin withholds the nature of tomorrow’s plan; mirror moon invents a physical blow.

findings.highlight: should I be ready for anything
findings.evidenceJa: 首だけは洗っておいた方がいい
findings.governingReading: perhaps I really should at least wash my neck
findings.explanation: The deadpan literal response to Rin’s idiom is replaced by a generic concern, erasing the joke’s mechanism.

findings.highlight: if I keep a girl at my place
findings.evidenceJa: 女の子を拘束していたら
findings.governingReading: if I detain a girl this late
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exaggeratedly formal “detain” language becomes neutral hosting.

findings.evidenceJa: 正体不明の存在
findings.governingReading: the unidentified entity
findings.explanation: Shirou jokingly treats casual-clothes Rin as unrecognizable; “alien” adds an extraterrestrial category.

findings.evidenceJa: 私服の遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin in casual clothes
findings.explanation: The positive visual identity driving Shirou’s reaction is only defined negatively, and her name disappears from the beat.

findings.evidenceJa: 宿泊道具一式
findings.governingReading: a complete set of overnight supplies
findings.explanation: Archer’s specific, comprehensive delivery becomes unspecified objects.

findings.evidenceJa: 承知しない
findings.governingReading: I will not tolerate it
findings.explanation: Rin’s forceful warning about oversleeping becomes a moralized promise to withhold forgiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の私服姿が頭に焼き付いたまま
findings.governingReading: with the sight of Rin in casual clothes still burned into my mind
findings.explanation: The precise visual attraction, clothing, and involuntary intensity collapse into the generic idea of thinking about Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: 頭から水を被って
findings.governingReading: pour water over my head
findings.explanation: The bodily action is generalized and “cold” is added, though cooling is the stated purpose.
